exH.q1: Who gets back in touch these days?
exH.q1a: Me, always. If I don't write, nothing happens.
exH.q1b: Me, nearly always. He replies, but he never starts.
exH.q1c: Both of us, about as often as each other.
exH.q1d: Him, often, and for no particular reason.
exH.q2a: Never. We haven't seen each other since the breakup.
exH.q2b: We have met up, but I'm the one who asked.
exH.q2c: He suggested it once, for a specific reason: belongings, a favour.
exH.q2d: He suggests seeing you with no pretext, just to see you.
exH.q3: Has he said anything clear about his feelings since the breakup?
exH.q3a: Yes: he told me it was over, and he has never gone back on it.
exH.q3b: No, nothing. The subject has never come up again.
exH.q3c: Hints, half-finished sentences, never anything clear.
exH.q3d: Yes: he told me he still thinks about me, or that he regrets it.
exH.q4: When he talks about the two of you, what tense does he use?
exH.q4a: He doesn't talk about it at all.
exH.q4b: The past, only. Memories, and nothing else.
exH.q4c: The present: what we've become, the way we speak to each other now.
exH.q4d: The future: things we could do again, a “maybe one day”.
exH.q5: What do you talk about when you do talk?
exH.q5b: Logistics: belongings, paperwork, the flat, the kids.
exH.q5c: Our lives, like two people who know each other well.
exH.q5d: Us: what happened, what we could have done differently.
exH.q6: What have his family and friends done since the breakup?
exH.q6a: They cut contact, like he did.
exH.q6b: They stay polite when we run into each other, nothing more.
exH.q6c: They keep in touch, but we never talk about him.
exH.q6d: They give me news of him, or tell me he still talks about me.
exH.q7: When you write to him, how does he reply?
exH.q7a: He doesn't reply, or he replies days later.
exH.q7b: A short, polite answer, and the conversation ends there.
exH.q7c: Within the day, and the conversation goes on for a while.
exH.q7d: Straight away, at any hour, and he's the one who keeps it going.
exH.q8: How does he react when he hears you're seeing someone?
exH.q8a: No reaction at all, or he's genuinely pleased for me.
exH.q8b: I have no idea, the subject has never come up.
exH.q8c: He asks questions: who it is, how long, whether it's serious.
exH.q8d: He turns cold or sarcastic, or he gets back in touch right afterwards.
exH.q9: Where do things stand with the belongings left at each other's place?
exH.q9a: Everything was returned within the week, he insisted on settling it fast.
exH.q9b: Everything was returned, with no particular urgency.
exH.q9c: There are still things on both sides, and neither of us mentions it.
exH.q9d: He draws it out: one item at a time, or he forgets to return the rest.
exH.q10: Where is he in his own life?
exH.q10a: He's in a relationship, and it looks serious.
exH.q10b: He's seeing people, going out, having fun.
exH.q10c: I have no idea, he shows nothing of his life.
exH.q10d: He's single, and he doesn't seem to be looking.
exH.q11: How long has his current behaviour been going on?
exH.q11a: The breakup is very recent, it's far too early to tell.
exH.q11b: A few weeks, with ups and downs.
exH.q11c: Several months, and it has stayed at the same rhythm.
exH.q11d: A long time, and he has never really disappeared from my life.
exH.q12a: He blocked my account, or he shut down his own.
exH.q12b: Nothing at all. He doesn't look, or I can't see it.
exH.q12d: He watches everything, reacts, likes what I post.
exH.q13: What happened to what was left of the two of you online?
exH.q13a: He deleted everything, and he did it fast.
exH.q13b: He cleaned up his social media, I don't know about the rest.
exH.q13c: The photos are still there, he hasn't touched them.
exH.q13d: He reposted one, or he sent me a photo of us.
exH.q14: What happens on birthdays and holidays?
exH.q14a: Nothing, not even for my birthday.
exH.q14b: A short message, the one he sends everybody.
exH.q14c: A personal message, one that shows he thought about it.
exH.q14d: He also marks the dates that belong to no one but the two of you.
exH.q15a: He did, explaining clearly why, and he stuck to it.
exH.q15b: He did, but without ever really explaining.
exH.q15c: I did, or we agreed on it together.
exH.q15d: Nobody really: it just stopped without anyone saying so.
